decision: Activate the selected shared closure repair after binding the two concrete pre-edit failures and exact controller inputs. Repair validation isolation and stage-specific dependencies before any future confirmation; keep the memory audit deferred, build mode gated, and independent transfer waiting. No scientific launch or external action is authorized.

categories.assessment: Exact-input validation and dependency-correct reuse are prerequisites for trustworthy, affordable future confirmation; this engineering repair outranks starting a new method.
The live-worktree ABA path and global-HEAD invalidation are reproduced from the current shared controller. The separate eighteen-receipt memory gap remains bounded and deferred.
The selected repair protects all later closure users. No upstream feedback or maintenance emergency displaces it, and transfer still lacks its owner-supplied input.
The work reuses the existing resumable controller and Git content identities; it needs focused implementation and regression evidence rather than a new literature method.
The selected item has exact local attack paths and completion tests and removes the explicit future-E1 gate. Build mode and transfer remain blocked; the memory audit is feasible but lower value.

candidates.rationale: The current controller and focused tests expose both bounded failures, all required inputs are local, and the plan supplies exact regressions plus full and separate-checkout closure gates.
The retained eighteen-receipt audit remains feasible, but it is narrower than the selected cross-item closure prerequisite.
Build-mode conformance still lacks bound supported configurations, input-influenced source sites, and a fixed reproducible protocol.

blockers.reason: Source/configuration and fixture/build protocol must be bound before promotion.

candidates.rationale: Independent transfer still lacks an owner-designated independently curated holdout package or new target evidence.

blockers.reason: The required independent input/custody package has not been supplied.
